S: Kellerman's devilled eggs and salmon rye
the guests' dining room at Kellerman's

Creamy devilled eggs dusted with paprika next to rye toasts with dill cream cheese and smoked salmon, served on a silver tray like 1963. Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water and halve. Mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, salt and a dash of hot sauce, pipe back in and dust with paprika. Toast 6 slices rye bread and cut into quarters. Mix 125g cream cheese with chopped dill and lemon zest, spread on the toasts and top with 150g smoked salmon and a sprig of dill.
Ice-cold watermelon cut into thick wedges, topped with crumbled feta, torn mint, a squeeze of lime and a pinch of flaky salt.
Staff cabin onion dip and pretzels
the after-hours dance party in the staff cabins

Pretzels and salty potato chips with a dip of slow-caramelised onions folded through sour cream and cream cheese with chives and a dash of Worcestershire. Slice 2 brown onions thinly and cook in 30g butter over low heat for 40 minutes, stirring often, until deep brown and jammy. Cool and chop finely. Beat 250g sour cream with 100g cream cheese, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce and salt, then fold in the onions and chopped chives. Chill 30 minutes. Serve with 200g pretzels and a 170g bag of potato chips.
M: Brisket braised at 150C for 4 hours on onions with stock, tomato paste and paprika, sliced, with the juices.
where the real dancing happens after hours

Two thin beef patties smashed on a hot griddle with American cheese, onion, pickles and mustard in a toasted soft bun, with a pile of crinkle-cut chips. Bake 750g frozen crinkle-cut chips at 220C for 25 minutes. Roll 600g beef mince into 8 balls. Heat a griddle or heavy pan until smoking, smash each ball thin with a spatula, season and cook 2 minutes, flip and lay a slice of American cheese on top for 1 minute. Toast 4 burger buns. Stack two patties in each bun with finely diced onion, pickles, mustard and tomato sauce.
W: she carried a watermelon, now she gets to eat one
Blend watermelon with lime and sugar syrup, strain, churn or freeze and scrape every 30 minutes.
K: the end of summer show at Kellerman's

Pineapple and orange juice with fresh ginger, lime and ginger ale over ice, loaded with sliced fruit and mint in a big glass punch bowl. Grate a 3cm piece of ginger into a punch bowl with the juice of 2 limes and 1 tbsp caster sugar and stir to dissolve. Add 1L pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice and chill for 1 hour. Just before serving add 1L cold ginger ale, a tray of ice, 1 sliced orange, a handful of pineapple chunks and torn mint.

m.how: Brown a 1.5kg brisket. Lay on 3 sliced onions in a roasting dish with 500ml stock, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tsp sweet paprika. Cover and braise at 150C for 4 hours. Slice across the grain and spoon over the juices.

w.note: she carried a watermelon, now she gets to eat one
w.how: Blitz 1kg watermelon flesh with the juice of 2 limes and 100g sugar dissolved in 100ml hot water. Strain, pour into a tray and freeze for 4 hours, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes. Scoop into cups.
